name: Crispy Smashed Potatoes
steps: Boil potatoes in water with half the salt for 18–22 minutes until a knife slips through but they still hold together.
Drain and let steam dry 5 minutes. Heat oven to 220°C and oil a large metal tray.
Place potatoes apart on the tray and press each down with a flat glass to about 1 cm thick. Drizzle remaining oil and scatter rosemary, pepper and salt.
Roast 25–30 minutes without flipping until the ragged edges are deeply golden and crisp. Rest 2 minutes before lifting so the crust releases cleanly.
tips: Space the potatoes well; crowding traps steam and softens the edges.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
